reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the known benefits of hollow nanostructures (P1, P5) and lattice strain (P18, P24) with the promotional effect of oxygenated species (P2, P13) into a new, testable causal chain: that deliberately reducing strain via annealing shifts selectivity toward CO2. No single passage proposes using post-synthesis annealing to tune strain in Pd@PtRh nanorings to decouple electronic effects from morphology and thereby drive the 12-electron pathway, making this a non-obvious integration.
